content.short: iMe is a feature-rich Telegram-based messenger with integrated TON wallet and DeFi capabilities.
content.description: iMe is an advanced alternative client for Telegram that significantly enhances the messaging experience by integrating a powerful multi-chain crypto wallet, including full support for TON. It allows users to manage their digital assets, participate in decentralized finance (DeFi), and execute token swaps directly within the chat interface. iMe also features its own native token, $LIME, and a variety of built-in mini-games. By merging social communication with sophisticated financial tools, iMe is a leading platform for SocialFi on the TON network.
content.meta: Upgrade your Telegram with iMe Messenger. Integrated TON wallet and DeFi on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
